trials.intent: Train a binary perceptron: for a misclassified sample add its features and one to the bias for a positive label; subtract them for a negative label.
Inference uses the dot product of feature weights with features plus the learned bias, consistently during training and prediction.
The node-feature perceptron weight moves toward a misclassified positive sample and away from a misclassified negative sample.
